summary: Sync a scenario's spec artifacts to match its implementation.
description: One or more agent rounds that read a scenario's implementation code and update its spec artifacts (PRD.md, requirements/, README.md, docs/) to match the actual behavior (mirrors internal/execution/service_queue.go QueueSpecSyncArchive). Targets a scenario workspace directly — there is no backlog item, plan, or review state; the deliverable is the scenario's own synced spec. On completion the execution service archives + removes the scenario directory. complete -> the spec is synced; blocked -> the sync cannot proceed.

inputs.name: OPERATOR_NOTE
inputs.description: Optional operator guidance for the spec-sync run.

fields.name: handoff
fields.description: Structured handoff: summary, blockers, next step, changed files, tests. The single artifact the next round consumes and the classifier derives progress from.

fields.name: progress
fields.description: Routing signal derived from the handoff: continue (another round is warranted), complete (the operation's unit of work is done), or blocked (needs operator attention).

outcomes.name: completed
outcomes.description: The operation's unit of work finished; the workflow advances (the execution service archives the scenario).

outcomes.name: continue
outcomes.description: Another round of the same operation is warranted; the loop continues.

outcomes.name: blocked
outcomes.description: Progress is blocked; the round parks for operator attention.

outcomes.name: needs-attention
outcomes.description: The classifier could not derive an honest outcome; the round abstains to operator attention.
